$comment: The ingestion component's GET /v1/latest 200 body and its error body (AD-1 component view v0.5 §3.1, P-1; approved for the D-24 slice only). DRAFT, like the envelope schema it refers to: `infra/scripts/check_contracts.py` does not cover contracts/events/ today, and the separate check is P-8 (Dev D). Rules that need a clock or the pair allowlist's ordering are in AD-1 §3.1 and §3.4, not here: a schema cannot see that `events` is sorted by base then quote, nor that each pair appears at most once.
title: Ingestion GET /v1/latest

instance_id.description: New at each ingestion start. Diagnostic only: consumers order by source_timestamp (AD-1 §3.4).

events.description: 0 to 4 AD-4 envelopes, at most one per pair, sorted by base then quote. Validated only: a quarantined event is never served (AD-1 §3.1).

error.description: No internal detail: no path, no traceback, no request echo (AD-1 §3.1).
